title: IPv4 Dynamic PAT at the Edge
scope: NAT overload with internal LAN, edge router, and simulated public server
acceptance: NAT table changes with at least two internal hosts; return connectivity works; translation entries observed

title: Static NAT and Inside Server Publishing
scope: Static one-to-one inside local/global address mapping and external-to-internal service validation
acceptance: Static translation visible; correct service reachable; no unrelated host exposed

title: DNS Records and HTTP Web Services
scope: Packet Tracer DNS server resolving multiple hostnames to HTTP services
acceptance: Correct names resolve; web clients load hosted pages; broken record fails then is fixed

title: NTP and Syslog Network Monitoring
scope: Router clock synchronization and centralized logging to a server
acceptance: Timestamp and remote logs observed; change or fault generates distinguishable event

title: CDP Neighbor Discovery and Topology Audit
scope: Discover Cisco neighbors and map interfaces using show commands
acceptance: Observed neighbor IDs/ports match topology; disabling CDP changes neighbor discovery

title: TFTP Configuration Backup and Restore
scope: Back up router configuration to an internal TFTP server, then recover in controlled scratch environment
acceptance: Genuine saved file and successful configuration recovery; no passwords or secrets copied into public evidence

title: IPv6 SLAAC and Neighbor Discovery
scope: Router advertisements, autoconfiguration, and IPv6 neighbor cache
acceptance: Hosts obtain valid IPv6 addresses; neighbor observations and bidirectional reachability verified

title: IPv6 Static and Default Route Troubleshooting
scope: IPv6 next-hop and default routes across three routers
acceptance: Global unicast connectivity and route table correct; deliberate missing route breaks expected traffic

title: Floating Static Routes and Administrative Distance
scope: Primary and backup routes with deliberate administrative distance separation
acceptance: Primary chosen normally; backup becomes active after real link failure; restoration verified

title: OSPFv2 DR and BDR Elections
scope: Multi-access Ethernet segment with router priorities and neighbor states
acceptance: Actual DR/BDR election observed and priorities tested; adjacencies stable

title: OSPFv2 Passive Interfaces and Neighbor Control
scope: Reduce unwanted OSPF neighbor formation while advertising local LANs
acceptance: Passive interface shown; LAN stays advertised; desired router neighbor remains

title: OSPFv2 Neighbor Adjacency Troubleshooting
scope: Diagnose and repair a deliberate mismatch in OSPF adjacency parameters
acceptance: Broken neighbor state demonstrated; root cause isolated; full adjacency and routes restored

title: HSRP First-Hop Gateway Failover
scope: Two gateway routers sharing a virtual IPv4 gateway and deliberate failover
acceptance: Virtual gateway remains reachable after active router failure; state transitions observed if supported

title: Stateful DHCPv6 Address Assignment
scope: DHCPv6 addressing and route advertisements with IPv6 clients
acceptance: Client addressing or DNS info obtained and verified using supported PT simulator features

title: Single-Area OSPFv3 for IPv6
scope: IPv6 neighbor adjacency and advertised subnets across connected routers
acceptance: OSPFv3 neighbors and learned IPv6 routes observed; invalid settings break expected adjacency

title: WPA2 Wireless LAN Fundamentals
scope: Small wireless LAN with access point, clients, WPA2 PSK and wired destination
acceptance: Correct credentials connect, wrong credentials fail, authorized client reaches wired server

title: Wireless VLAN Separation and Guest Access
scope: Guest versus staff wireless separation using supported AP/router features
acceptance: Guest cannot reach staff target but reaches designated service, if actual device supports design

title: DNS Resolution Failure Troubleshooting
scope: Diagnose wrong DNS settings, missing A records, and client name-resolution errors
acceptance: IP connectivity works while name fails; correct DNS fix restores name access

title: DHCP Snooping and Rogue DHCP Detection
scope: Trusted/untrusted switch ports and unauthorized DHCP server containment
acceptance: Unauthorized offers denied, legitimate lease succeeds, actual switch counters verified

title: Dynamic ARP Inspection and Spoofing Defense
scope: Switch DAI supported behavior with DHCP snooping bindings
acceptance: Unsupported forged ARP dropped while legitimate ARP works; counters observed if supported

title: Port Security Violation Troubleshooting
scope: Diagnose sticky MAC limits and port err-disable/recovery states
acceptance: Violation counters/status observed; correct recovery restores link without disabling security

title: IPv4 ACL Troubleshooting with Traffic Matrix
scope: Find ordering/placement mistakes in standard and extended ACLs
acceptance: Defined allowed/blocked matrix verified with traffic probes and corrected ACL

title: Named Extended IPv4 ACL for Server Access
scope: Create specific named ACLs that permit DNS/HTTP and deny forbidden destinations
acceptance: Traffic matrix validates per-service permissions; show access-lists counts meaningful

title: NAT and PAT Troubleshooting Challenge
scope: Diagnose NAT inside/outside misconfiguration and translation ACL errors
acceptance: Failed translation reproduced; root issue fixed and translations demonstrated

title: VLAN Trunk Allowed-List Troubleshooting
scope: Find pruning and native-VLAN mistakes without changing unrelated ports
acceptance: Selected VLAN fails while other works; corrected allowed list restores intended connectivity

title: Spanning Tree Root and Blocked-Port Investigation
scope: Investigate unexpected root bridge and alternate port behavior
acceptance: Before/after root IDs, roles and topology recorded and corrected

title: LACP EtherChannel Member Mismatch Diagnosis
scope: Troubleshoot channel members with incompatible port mode or VLAN settings
acceptance: Channel state shows mismatch; corrected bundle passes both reachability and show etherchannel

title: VLSM Address Plan Fault Investigation
scope: Repair overlapping and wrong-prefix errors in a multi-subnet topology
acceptance: Addressing plan validated; planned broken reachability repaired with minimum config changes

title: Multi-Site Routing with Branch Networks
scope: Connect three offices with explicit WAN addressing and route design
acceptance: All intended paths reachable, missing branch route yields demonstrable failure

title: Campus Distribution and Access VLAN Design
scope: Two access switches with multilayer distribution for multiple groups
acceptance: Inter-VLAN reaches permitted services; trunks, SVIs, and routing shown accurately

title: Guest Network Segmentation with ACLs
scope: Isolate guest subnet from internal resources while allowing designated services
acceptance: Positive and negative guest traffic matrix recorded, including blocked internal reachability

title: DMZ Services with Edge ACL Policy
scope: Public-facing test server in a DMZ with restricted internal reachability
acceptance: Simulated outside clients reach DMZ target, internal protection enforced by observed ACL

title: DHCP Relay Troubleshooting Across VLANs
scope: Diagnose helper-address and DHCP scope errors with remote VLAN clients
acceptance: Real lease obtained after correction; wrong helper failure reproduced

title: Secure Management Network Design
scope: Separate management VLAN, SSH-only access, and basic ACL limits
acceptance: Management PC reaches authorized devices over SSH; guest PC denied; Telnet disabled

title: Dual-Stack IPv4 and IPv6 Branch Network
scope: Combined IPv4+IPv6 reachability with static routes across two branches
acceptance: Both address families pass complete matrix; intentional IPv6 route fault isolated

title: Integrated Branch Network Troubleshooting Challenge
scope: Multiple isolated misconfigurations involving VLAN, route, ACL, and DHCP
acceptance: Students diagnose several separate faults; golden solution passes complete traffic matrix
